d: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) is holding a protest against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Kochi, Kerala. Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and actor-activist Prakash Raj are expected to join the ‘Jantar Mantar at Kochi’ march at Rajendra Maidan. The protest comes weeks after CJP leaders were arrested during demonstrations in Delhi and amid a row over allegations of foreign funding. Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has backed the group's right to protest, saying, “We believe in democracy; let them protest.”
